bounded_conclusion: The ordinary base is 4 feet from each north and south interior side line. The narrow-lot branch is excluded, and optional reallocation cannot reduce either line below 4 feet here. The final project-specific requirement remains conditional; current structure compliance is not evaluated.

conditions: A controlling document, program, or overlay modifies the base-zone side setback

evidence_needed_to_select.element: Element classification and geometry sufficient to test every applicable §131.0461(a) condition.
evidence_needed_to_select.established_setback: Approval/history and compliance-grade dimension for any established reallocated side setback.
evidence_needed_to_select.fire: Project-specific Fire Code Official evidence accepted by Packet 35.
evidence_needed_to_select.modifications: Project/document review sufficient to exclude or apply controlling setback modifications and special programs.
evidence_needed_to_select.project: Current/proposed project type, structure classification, and whether work is an addition.

historical_diagnostic.reason: Packet 17 retains geometry hashes rather than coordinates, uses a Spring 2017 imagery baseline, and does not prove current completeness or compliance-grade registration to the legal side lines.

mandatory_qualifier: This evaluates only the current outside-Coastal RS-1-7 interior-side-setback rule envelope. It does not establish current structure compliance, overall zoning compliance, capacity, legal nonconformity, or project approval.

measurement_doctrine.above_grade_scope: Above-grade portions of underground parking, first stories, and basements are subject to setbacks; completely underground structures have the bounded exception in §113.0252(b).
measurement_doctrine.accessory_treatment: The §131.0461(a)(12) garage/non-habitable accessory-building permission is unavailable because lot area exceeds 10,000 square feet; other accessory standards remain project/classification dependent.
measurement_doctrine.direction: Measured inward and perpendicular to the applicable north or south side property line (SDMC §113.0252(a)(2)).
measurement_doctrine.projection_treatment: Roof projections, openly supported projections, bay windows, fireplaces, mechanical equipment, patios, dormers, low unroofed structures, pools/spas/hot tubs, and qualifying small-lot accessory buildings each retain their own §131.0461(a) conditions; no permission is selected without element facts.
required_inputs: current authoritative structure geometry registered to legal boundaries
measurement_doctrine.setback_line: For each side, a line parallel to the nearest side property line at the required inward distance; the intervening area is the required side yard (SDMC §113.0249(a)).

source.publisher: City of San Diego, Office of the City Clerk
source.scope: Referenced, unevaluated definitions and measurement rules, including section 113.0246(f).
source.title: San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 11, Article 3, Division 2: Rules for Calculation and Measurement

measurement_doctrine.structure_edge: For new-development compliance, measured to the outer edge of the building frame (SDMC §113.0252(c)); qualifying element-specific projections and encroachments remain governed by §131.0461(a).

accessory_or_element_classification.basis: No current or proposed element is classified.
accessory_or_element_classification.effect: Controls element-specific projection, equipment, patio, pool, unroofed-structure, and other encroachment rules.

application_complete_date.basis: This evaluator is limited to the current-version profile and does not adjudicate a protected earlier application.
application_complete_date.effect: Earlier applications require a separately versioned evaluation.

combined_table_side_setback_total.basis: This non-corner lot has two interior side lines and the RS-1-7 table minimum is 4 feet for each.
combined_table_side_setback_total.effect: A reallocation must preserve at least the 8-foot combined total.

completely_underground_structure.effect: Completely underground construction has separate treatment.

current_outside_coastal_profile.basis: The parcel is supported outside Coastal and uses the current reviewed rule set.
current_outside_coastal_profile.effect: Selects the current outside-Coastal authority envelope.
current_outside_coastal_profile.source: Parcel Intelligence V2 + RS Base Standards V0

document_modified_setback.basis: The legal-lot chain is not a complete search for every ordinance, final subdivision, record of survey, or division-plat setback modification.
document_modified_setback.effect: A controlling document can replace the calculated line.
document_modified_setback.source: SDMC §113.0249(b)-(c) + Legal Lot Evidence V0 limitation

established_side_setback_dimension.basis: Historical outlines do not establish an approved reallocation or compliance-grade current dimension.
established_side_setback_dimension.effect: Needed if the project is an addition subject to continuation rules.

existing_primary_structure_addition.basis: No proposed project scope or complete established-side-setback history is supplied.
existing_primary_structure_addition.effect: An addition may have to maintain an established reallocated side setback.

fire_official_defensible_space_buffer.basis: Packet 35 proves that mapped fire geography does not select a number; project review is required.
fire_official_defensible_space_buffer.effect: May require a buffer greater than the otherwise applicable side setback.
fire_official_defensible_space_buffer.source: Fire Defensible Space Predicate V0 + SDMC §131.0443(i)

garage_within_embankment_rule.basis: Section 131.0449(a) applies only to front and street-side yards.
garage_within_embankment_rule.effect: Does not alter an interior-side setback.

interior_side_property_lines.basis: PM 17383 and §113.0246(d) resolve both non-street lines connecting east front to west rear as interior side lines.
interior_side_property_lines.source: PM 17383 sheet 2 + Minimum Lot Width Evaluation V0

lot_is_non_corner.effect: Uses the ordinary RS-1-7 minimum-width row and excludes street-side evaluation.

lot_width_greater_than_50_ft.basis: The sealed Code-defined width is 94.00 feet.
lot_width_greater_than_50_ft.effect: Makes optional side-setback reallocation legally available.

lot_width_less_than_zone_minimum.basis: The sealed Code-defined width is 94.00 feet and the ordinary RS-1-7 minimum is 50 feet.
lot_width_less_than_zone_minimum.source: Minimum Lot Width Evaluation V0 + Table 131-04D

permitted_projection_or_encroachment.basis: No proposed element is tested against §131.0461(a)(1)-(12).
permitted_projection_or_encroachment.effect: Can change the allowed element edge while preserving the building-frame base setback.

reallocated_interior_side_floor.basis: Section 131.0443(a)(4)(B)(ii) bars a reallocated side setback below 4 feet.
reallocated_interior_side_floor.effect: For this parcel, reallocation cannot reduce either interior side below the table base.

required_street_or_alley_dedication.basis: The north and south interior lines abut land and are not street or alley lines in the sealed recorded map.
required_street_or_alley_dedication.effect: No alley remapping or current side-line dedication branch is selected.

resubdivided_corner_lot.basis: The parcel is a single-frontage interior non-corner recorded lot.

side_setback_reallocation_elected.basis: No proposed project, approved reallocation, or established-side-setback record is supplied.
side_setback_reallocation_elected.effect: Controls whether the optional reallocation/continuation branch is selected.

small_lot_accessory_building_encroachmen.basis: The sealed Code lot area is 22,096.320 square feet, above the 10,000-square-foot ceiling.
small_lot_accessory_building_encroachmen.effect: Excludes the garage/non-habitable accessory-building side-yard encroachment.
small_lot_accessory_building_encroachmen.source: Minimum Lot Area Evaluation V0 + SDMC §131.0461(a)(12)

special_program_or_overlay_modification.basis: No project/program scope or complete overlay-specific setback review is supplied.
special_program_or_overlay_modification.effect: A separate applicable regulation may modify the base-zone envelope.

setback_family_assessment.shared_pattern: Evidence gates → rule selection → explicit predicates → valid branches → measurement doctrine → compliance gates → contained result.
setback_family_assessment.side_specific_extension: Paired side lines add strict width thresholds, a combined-total reallocation permission with line-specific floors, and established-side continuation for additions without changing the shared evaluator contract.

width_analysis.strict_threshold_note: Exactly 50 feet satisfies neither strict inequality.
